title: PAW Trace Closed-Loop Historical Replay v1

cases.title: Codex provider request-field compatibility

detectedBy.boundary: The read-only Trace Agent independently named the incompatible field; it did not apply the Runtime repair.

proposedBy.boundary: The Trace Agent produced an unapplied candidate repair.

authorizedBy.boundary: The public receipt does not carry the authorization actor receipt.

implementedBy.boundary: The public receipt proves a two-file TDD repair but does not identify the implementing Agent.

verifiedBy.boundary: Focused candidate tests moved from 37 passed and one failed to 38 passed.
The source-local candidate completed the same read-only Trace path.

before.summary: The same Codex request failed over HTTP streaming and WebSocket before any diagnostic Skill or Tool call completed.

finding.summary: A request field unsupported by the Codex backend was added by the provider adapter.

evidence.summary: Same-payload transport A/B isolated the incompatible request field.
A fresh read-only Trace run independently produced the same diagnosis.

candidateChange.summary: Omit the unsupported request field for the Codex provider adapter while leaving other provider contracts unchanged.
boundaries: The in-product Trace Agent did not implement the repair.

after.summary: Both transport variants completed, focused tests passed, and the same Trace path produced a persisted report.

boundaries: Source-local candidate evidence does not prove installation or foreground acceptance.

cases.title: Trace diagnostic exact-envelope contract

detectedBy.boundary: Two retained finalize failures exposed the output-contract mismatch.

proposedBy.boundary: The public receipt does not identify which supervisor or repair Agent authored the exact-envelope proposal.

authorizedBy.boundary: No public authorization actor receipt is retained.

implementedBy.boundary: The Skill diff is verified, but its implementing Agent is not identified by the public receipt.

verifiedBy.boundary: Twenty-two focused tests passed after the Skill change.
A fresh neutral read-only Trace Session produced a valid persisted report.

before.summary: Two Trace report attempts reached finalize but were rejected for envelope drift, including a numeric confidence value.

finding.summary: The diagnostic Skill described the report semantically but did not pin the only legal top-level envelope and confidence enum.

evidence.summary: The retained validation receipt records both distinct contract rejections.
The post-change Trace Session completed without unsupported findings.

candidateChange.summary: Add a mandatory exact-envelope checklist with fixed top-level keys, no extra properties, string confidence values, and unknown-preserving empty evidence behavior.
boundaries: Runtime schema semantics were not changed.
Invalid reports were not coerced into valid ones.

after.summary: A fresh read-only Session completed Skill load and inspection, then persisted a valid report while preserving missing usage as unknown.

boundaries: The candidate was source-local, dirty-source-derived, and not an installed release.

cases.title: CloudOps observation addressing contract

detectedBy.boundary: The retained bounded-workflow receipt isolated one Tool-addressing failure without attributing every quality miss to it.

proposedBy.boundary: The receipt predeclared a Tool-only short-identifier falsification.

authorizedBy.boundary: The public receipts do not identify the authorizing actor.

implementedBy.boundary: The candidate implementation exists, but no public actor receipt attributes it.

verifiedBy.boundary: The same frozen Validation suite verified Tool success and diagnosis-quality regression.

before.summary: One Agent-composed long cache key was absent from the blind index; the bounded workflow also missed quality cases for unrelated reasons.

finding.summary: The public Tool contract required the Agent to transcribe a long opaque address into a later read call.

evidence.summary: The before receipt separates the single addressing failure from the broader quality misses.
The after receipt records zero Tool failures and material diagnosis regressions.

candidateChange.summary: Replace public long cache keys with deterministic case-scoped observation identifiers while resolving private cache keys inside the Tool owner.
boundaries: The reasoning prompt, gold, scorer, cases, and declared budgets remained frozen.

after.summary: All reads used short observation identifiers and no Tool call failed, but diagnosis quality regressed materially.

boundaries: Local Tool-contract success does not establish product-level workflow improvement.
These are known historical replay cases, not blind or Held-out evidence.
The public manifest is a post-evaluation UI projection and must never be supplied as diagnosis input.
Host-private span, owner, evidence-group, and supported-conclusion gold is intentionally absent.
Unknown actor attribution is preserved instead of assigning supervisor work to the Trace Agent.
